responsibility: Defines the top-level RTL machine description for AMD GCN instruction selection and output. It includes the predicate and constraint files, declares target-specific unspec codes, constants, and instruction attributes, and describes core scalar/vector, memory, atomic, barrier, and OpenACC/OpenMP-related RTL patterns and assembly templates, while delegating the dense vector-ALU pattern families to the included gcn-valu.md file.
same_name_distinction: This is the machine-description file for GCN instruction selection and assembly templates: unlike gcn.cc it expresses behavior declaratively through define_insn/define_expand patterns, unlike gcn.h it is not the C/C++ target header of macros and ABI constants, and unlike gcn.opt it does not define command-line switches.
